plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Konopka & Benzer (September 1971, PNAS 68: 2112–2116) Drosophila eclosion & locomotor activity rhythm chart compares wild-type (24.0 h period), per^01 (arrhythmic), per^S (19.0 h period), and per^L1 (28.0 h period) all mapping to a single locus on the X chromosome.

teach_overlay.scale: changing a single genetic letter inside the Period gene was like turning the regulating screw on the back of a grandfather clock — speeding a fly's entire day up to nineteen hours or slowing it down to twenty-eight
